shared_elements: animals shown in profile in low relief
quadruped with legs and head turned
row/register of animal figures along the upper part
figures placed against a plain, unfilled ground
justification: Both are upright rectangular stone faces carrying profile animals in a band across the upper zone with further motifs below on an otherwise blank ground, which is the most specific correspondence. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is deeply modelled, crowded, multi-register relief with birds, a horned quadruped, snake-like and human-like forms, while B is a thinly incised, sparse composition inside a ruled border dominated by a large swirling disc that has no counterpart in A.
